title: Feasibility of implementing a multicultural curriculum through artificial intelligence: perspectives of educational science experts.
abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) tools increasingly permeate education systems, they intersect with long-standing efforts to design and implement multicultural curricula aimed at equity, representation, and critical consciousness. Policy frameworks emphasise “human-centred” AI and cultural diversity.
